notice: Model records in src/data/models.json are synthetic fixtures. No public data release exists yet; release entries describe a provisional plan.

releases.status_note: Provisional. Conversion to the release formats is in progress. Data are licensed CC BY 4.0 and the accompanying code BSD-3-Clause; the DOI and hosting are not yet decided.

summary.suite: Core Sgas10 environmental suite (TIGRESS-NCR, fixed microphysics)
summary.units: Hydrogen number density n_H in cm^-3, lengths in pc, velocities in km/s, time in code units of 1 pc/(km/s) = 0.978 Myr.
summary.numbering: File number = output time / cadence, so 3D snapshot 0050 is t = 500.
summary.size_basis: Planned estimates per model, before final conversion.

products.contents: Time, cluster and explosion position, ambient state, runaway flag
Mass, age, position, velocity, metal masses, role flag
20 fields: n_H, v, P, B, Φ, T, rates, radiation, Z, f_ej, x_HI, x_H2, x_e
17 column-density, emission-measure, kinematic, and magnetic maps
x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 planes of the primitive and chemical fields
149 horizontally averaged quantities for the whole box and 14 phases
n–P histograms weighted by volume, mass, species, and heating/cooling channels

summary.formats: Gridded outputs follow the Athena++ HDF5 layout: one mesh block per original tile and an XDMF companion. Primitive variables, the gravitational potential, and the passive scalars are in the prim dataset, the cell-centred magnetic field in B, and all other fields in user_out_var. The standard Athena++ reader (athena_read), yt, VisIt, and ParaView open them without a custom loader.

passive_scalars.name: Z
passive_scalars.meaning: Gas metallicity, initialized at solar and enriched by supernova ejecta
